newsitem.title: UK: BZW appoints intl asset finance head in London.
newsitem.headline: BZW appoints intl asset finance head in London.

text.p: BZW, the investment banking arm of British banking giant Barclays, said on Thursday it had appointed Graham Andersen to the new post of international asset finance head.
The role was created by BZW's decision to merge its structured bond finance and asset securitisation capabilities, it said in a statement.
Andersen has relocated from Sydney, Australia and will be responsible for all asset securitisation, including structured finance bonds for the European and Australasian regions, including Japan.
